title: 🚨 YOU’RE NOT UNQUALIFIED… YOU’RE JUST AVOIDING THE MOMENT THAT MATTERS
paragraphs: 🚨 YOU’RE NOT UNQUALIFIED… YOU’RE JUST AVOIDING THE MOMENT THAT MATTERS
Let’s be real.
You know your family needs God.
You feel it.

But when it’s time to lead?
You hesitate.

You scroll.
You delay.
You tell yourself… “I’ll start when I’m ready.”
That moment never comes.

And slowly…
your home becomes spiritually silent.
“How to Lead Family Devotions (Even If You Feel Unqualified)”
This is not another soft Christian read.
This is a wake-up call.

Because the truth is—
your family doesn’t need a perfect leader.
They need a present one.
🔥 WHAT THIS BOOK WILL DO FOR YOU:

• Break the lie that you’re “not ready”
• Show you exactly how to lead simple devotions (even if you don’t know what to say)
• Help you overcome fear, inconsistency, and spiritual passivity
• Give you a step-by-step structure you can start TONIGHT
• Teach you how to lead even while you’re still growing
⚔️ HERE’S THE TRUTH MOST WON’T SAY:

Most people wait until they feel confident.
Few obey while they still feel weak.

Most avoid spiritual responsibility.
Few rise and lead their homes.

Most want a godly family someday.
Few build it daily.
So which one are you?
🔒 EXCLUSIVE ACCESS (NOT PUBLIC)
This book is NOT available to everyone.
This is for people who are DONE making excuses.
This is for people ready to LEAD.
If you know it’s time to step up…
If you’re tired of spiritual passivity…
If you want your home to actually follow Christ—
Become the leader your family needs.
